==> packages/db/src/lp-positions.ts <==
import {
  canTransitionLpPosition,
  type LpChain,
  type LpPositionState
} from '@swat/shared';
import { query } from './client.js';
import type { LpProtocol } from './lp-pools.js';
import { isCrossTenant, type UserScope } from './tenancy.js';
import { withTransaction } from './transaction.js';

/**
 * User LP positions and their state machine (`059`).
 *
 * `transitionLpPosition` is the only writer of `lp_positions.state`. It runs
 * the shared predicate (`canTransitionLpPosition`) and the SQL trigger enforces
 * the same table a second time, so the two cannot drift silently: code drift is
 * caught by the trigger raising, trigger drift is caught by the code refusing
 * before the statement is even sent.
 *
 * The monitor sweep (`listPositionsForMonitor`) crosses tenants by design and
 * therefore requires a `crossTenantScope` at the call site, like every other
 * platform sweep in this package.
 */

export type LpStrategyType = 'spot' | 'curve' | 'bidask';

/** One ladder rung. Meteora rungs carry bin ids; Uniswap rungs carry tick bounds. */
export interface LpRungAllocation {
  readonly priceLower: number;
  readonly priceUpper: number;
  /** Fraction of the deposit assigned to this rung, 0..1. Rungs sum to ≤ 1. */
  readonly weight: number;
  readonly binId?: number;
  readonly tickLower?: number;
  readonly tickUpper?: number;
}

export interface LpPosition {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly userId: string;
  readonly chain: LpChain;
  readonly protocol: LpProtocol;
  /** Chain-prefixed. */
  readonly poolAddress: string;
  readonly strategyType: LpStrategyType;
  readonly rangeLower: number;
  readonly rangeUpper: number;
  readonly rungAllocations: readonly LpRungAllocation[];
  readonly depositAmount: number;
  /** Chain-prefixed mint of the single deposit token. */
  readonly depositAsset: string;
  readonly state: LpPositionState;
  /** Chain-prefixed; null while building or paper-only. */
  readonly onChainPositionAddress: string | null;
  /**
   * Track I: the owner's opt-in to automatic rebalancing. The scheduled
   * monitor only queues rebalances for opted-in positions; manual triggers
   * bypass this flag (the user IS the consent).
   */
  readonly autoRebalance: boolean;
  readonly openedAt: Date;
  readonly closedAt: Date | null;
  readonly updatedAt: Date;
}

interface PositionRow {
  id: string;
  user_id: string;
  chain: LpChain;
  protocol: LpProtocol;
  pool_address: string;
  strategy_type: LpStrategyType;
  range_lower: number | string;
  range_upper: number | string;
  rung_allocations: unknown;
  deposit_amount: number | string;
  deposit_asset: string;
  state: LpPositionState;
  on_chain_position_address: string | null;
  auto_rebalance: boolean;
  opened_at: Date;
  closed_at: Date | null;
  updated_at: Date;
}

const POSITION_COLUMNS =
  'id, user_id, chain, protocol, pool_address, strategy_type, range_lower, range_upper, ' +
  'rung_allocations, deposit_amount, deposit_asset, state, on_chain_position_address, ' +
  'auto_rebalance, opened_at, closed_at, updated_at';

function toSafeNumber(value: number | string): number {
  if (typeof value === 'number') return value;
  const parsed = Number(value);
  if (!Number.isFinite(parsed)) {
    throw new Error(`stored NUMERIC ${String(value)} does not fit a float64`);
  }
  return parsed;
}

function toRungAllocations(value: unknown): LpRungAllocation[] {
  if (!Array.isArray(value)) return [];
  return value.map((entry) => {
    const rung = entry as Record<string, unknown>;
    return {
      priceLower: Number(rung.priceLower),
      priceUpper: Number(rung.priceUpper),
      weight: Number(rung.weight),
      binId: rung.binId === undefined ? undefined : Number(rung.binId),
      tickLower: rung.tickLower === undefined ? undefined : Number(rung.tickLower),
      tickUpper: rung.tickUpper === undefined ? undefined : Number(rung.tickUpper)
    };
  });
}

function toPosition(row: PositionRow): LpPosition {
  return {
    id: row.id,
    userId: row.user_id,
    chain: row.chain,
    protocol: row.protocol,
    poolAddress: row.pool_address,
    strategyType: row.strategy_type,
    rangeLower: toSafeNumber(row.range_lower),
    rangeUpper: toSafeNumber(row.range_upper),
    rungAllocations: toRungAllocations(row.rung_allocations),
    depositAmount: toSafeNumber(row.deposit_amount),
    depositAsset: row.deposit_asset,
    state: row.state,
    onChainPositionAddress: row.on_chain_position_address,
    autoRebalance: row.auto_rebalance,
    openedAt: row.opened_at,
    closedAt: row.closed_at,
    updatedAt: row.updated_at
  };
}

function assertRungs(rungs: readonly LpRungAllocation[]): void {
  let totalWeight = 0;
  for (const rung of rungs) {
    if (
      !Number.isFinite(rung.priceLower) || rung.priceLower <= 0
      || !Number.isFinite(rung.priceUpper) || rung.priceUpper <= rung.priceLower
    ) {
      throw new Error(`invalid ladder rung price bounds: ${rung.priceLower}..${rung.priceUpper}`);
    }
    if (!Number.isFinite(rung.weight) || rung.weight < 0 || rung.weight > 1) {
      throw new Error(`ladder rung weight must be a finite fraction in 0..1, got ${rung.weight}`);
    }
    totalWeight += rung.weight;
  }
  if (totalWeight > 1 + 1e-9) {
    throw new Error(`ladder rung weights must sum to at most 1, got ${totalWeight}`);
  }
}

export interface CreateLpPositionInput {
  readonly chain: LpChain;
  readonly protocol: LpProtocol;
  /** Chain-prefixed. */
  readonly poolAddress: string;
  readonly strategyType: LpStrategyType;
  readonly rangeLower: number;
  readonly rangeUpper: number;
  readonly rungAllocations: readonly LpRungAllocation[];
  readonly depositAmount: number;
  /** Chain-prefixed. */
  readonly depositAsset: string;
  /** Track I: opt into automatic rebalancing at deploy time. Default false. */
  readonly autoRebalance?: boolean;
}

export async function createLpPosition(
  scope: UserScope,
  input: CreateLpPositionInput
): Promise<LpPosition> {
  if (!Number.isFinite(input.depositAmount) || input.depositAmount <= 0) {
    throw new Error(`lp_positions.deposit_amount must be a positive finite number, got ${input.depositAmount}`);
  }
  if (!Number.isFinite(input.rangeLower) || input.rangeLower <= 0
    || !Number.isFinite(input.rangeUpper) || input.rangeUpper <= input.rangeLower) {
    throw new Error(`lp_positions range must satisfy 0 < rangeLower < rangeUpper, got ${input.rangeLower}..${input.rangeUpper}`);
  }
  assertRungs(input.rungAllocations);
  if (input.poolAddress.indexOf(':') < 0 || input.depositAsset.indexOf(':') < 0) {
    throw new Error('lp_positions pool and deposit addresses must be chain-prefixed');
  }

  return withTransaction(async (client) => {
    const rows = await client.query<PositionRow>(
      `INSERT INTO lp_positions
         (user_id, chain, protocol, pool_address, strategy_type, range_lower, range_upper,
          rung_allocations, deposit_amount, deposit_asset, state, auto_rebalance)
       VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8::jsonb, $9, $10, 'building', $11)
       RETURNING ${POSITION_COLUMNS}`,
      [
        scope.userId,
        input.chain,
        input.protocol,
        input.poolAddress,
        input.strategyType,
        input.rangeLower,
        input.rangeUpper,
        JSON.stringify(input.rungAllocations),
        input.depositAmount,
        input.depositAsset,
        input.autoRebalance ?? false
      ]
    );
    const position = rows.rows[0]!;
    await client.query(
      `INSERT INTO lp_position_state_history (position_id, from_state, to_state, reason)
       VALUES ($1, NULL, 'building', 'position created')`,
      [position.id]
    );
    return toPosition(position);
  });
}

export async function getLpPosition(scope: UserScope, positionId: string): Promise<LpPosition | null> {
  const rows = await query<PositionRow>(
    `SELECT ${POSITION_COLUMNS} FROM lp_positions WHERE id = $1 AND user_id = $2`,
    [positionId, scope.userId]
  );
  return rows[0] ? toPosition(rows[0]) : null;
}

/**
 * Worker-side read of one position regardless of owner. Platform sweep — pass
 * `crossTenantScope(reason)`. The execution worker receives only the position
 * id in its job payload and must be able to see any user's row to refuse
 * acting on one that closed (or never left `building`) between enqueue and run.
 */
export async function getLpPositionAnyOwner(scope: UserScope, positionId: string): Promise<LpPosition | null> {
  if (!isCrossTenant(scope)) {
    throw new Error('getLpPositionAnyOwner is a platform read; pass crossTenantScope(reason)');
  }
  const rows = await query<PositionRow>(
    `SELECT ${POSITION_COLUMNS} FROM lp_positions WHERE id = $1`,
    [positionId]
  );
  return rows[0] ? toPosition(rows[0]) : null;
}

export async function listLpPositions(
  scope: UserScope,
  options: { includeClosed?: boolean; limit?: number } = {}
): Promise<LpPosition[]> {
  const limit = options.limit ?? 100;
  if (!Number.isInteger(limit) || limit < 1 || limit > 500) {
    throw new Error(`listLpPositions limit must be an integer in 1..500, got ${limit}`);
  }
  const rows = options.includeClosed
    ? await query<PositionRow>(
        `SELECT ${POSITION_COLUMNS} FROM lp_positions
          WHERE user_id = $1
          ORDER BY opened_at DESC
          LIMIT $2`,
        [scope.userId, limit]
      )
    : await query<PositionRow>(
        `SELECT ${POSITION_COLUMNS} FROM lp_positions
          WHERE user_id = $1 AND state <> 'closed'
          ORDER BY opened_at DESC
          LIMIT $2`,
        [scope.userId, limit]
      );
  return rows.map(toPosition);
}

/**
 * Open positions due for a monitor pass on one chain. Platform sweep — pass
 * `crossTenantScope('lp position monitor sweep')`. Served by
 * idx_lp_positions_monitor.
 */
export async function listPositionsForMonitor(
  scope: UserScope,
  chain: LpChain,
  limit = 500
): Promise<LpPosition[]> {
  if (!isCrossTenant(scope)) {
    throw new Error('listPositionsForMonitor is a platform sweep; pass crossTenantScope(reason)');
  }
  if (!Number.isInteger(limit) || limit < 1 || limit > 2000) {
    throw new Error(`listPositionsForMonitor limit must be an integer in 1..2000, got ${limit}`);
  }
  const rows = await query<PositionRow>(
    `SELECT ${POSITION_COLUMNS} FROM lp_positions
      WHERE chain = $1 AND state IN ('active', 'near_edge', 'out_of_range')
      ORDER BY updated_at
      LIMIT $2`,
    [chain, limit]
  );
  return rows.map(toPosition);
}

/**
 * Track I: flips the auto-rebalance opt-in. A preference write, not a state
 * transition — it must not touch `state` or the journal.
 */
export async function setLpPositionAutoRebalance(
  scope: UserScope,
  positionId: string,
  enabled: boolean
): Promise<void> {
  await query(
    `UPDATE lp_positions
       SET auto_rebalance = $3, updated_at = NOW()
       WHERE id = $1 AND user_id = $2`,
    [positionId, scope.userId, enabled]
  );
}

export interface LpPositionStateTransition {
  readonly toState: LpPositionState;
  /** Required for every transition; the history row is the audit trail. */
  readonly reason: string;
}

/**
 * The only writer of `lp_positions.state`.
 *
 * Locks the row FOR UPDATE first so two racing transitions (monitor sweep vs.
 * user close) serialize instead of both passing the predicate on the same
 * pre-image. Refusing a transition leaves the row untouched — a refused
 * transition that still writes is the failure mode the history table exists to
 * catch.
 */
export async function transitionLpPosition(
  scope: UserScope,
  positionId: string,
  transition: LpPositionStateTransition
): Promise<LpPosition> {
  if (!transition.reason || transition.reason.trim().length === 0) {
    throw new Error('transitionLpPosition requires a reason');
  }
  const filterByUser = !isCrossTenant(scope);

  return withTransaction(async (client) => {
    // Ownership rides in the locked SELECT rather than a pre-check outside the
    // transaction: one round trip, and no window where a row passes the check
    // and is gone before the lock.
    const locked = await client.query<PositionRow>(
      `SELECT ${POSITION_COLUMNS} FROM lp_positions
        WHERE id = $1 ${filterByUser ? 'AND user_id = $2' : ''}
        FOR UPDATE`,
      filterByUser ? [positionId, scope.userId] : [positionId]
    );
    if (locked.rows.length === 0) {
      throw new Error(
        `lp position ${positionId} not found${filterByUser ? ' for this user' : ''}`
      );
    }
    const current = toPosition(locked.rows[0]!);
    if (!canTransitionLpPosition(current.state, transition.toState)) {
      throw new Error(
        `invalid lp position transition: ${current.state} -> ${transition.toState}`
      );
    }

    const updated = await client.query<PositionRow>(
      `UPDATE lp_positions
         SET state = $2,
             closed_at = CASE WHEN $2 = 'closed' THEN NOW() ELSE closed_at END,
             updated_at = NOW()
         WHERE id = $1
         RETURNING ${POSITION_COLUMNS}`,
      [positionId, transition.toState]
    );
    await client.query(
      `INSERT INTO lp_position_state_history (position_id, from_state, to_state, reason)
       VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4)`,
      [positionId, current.state, transition.toState, transition.reason]
    );
    return toPosition(updated.rows[0]!);
  });
}

/** Track E wiring: records the on-chain position address once the ladder is built. */
export async function attachOnChainPositionAddress(
  scope: UserScope,
  positionId: string,
  onChainPositionAddress: string
): Promise<void> {
  if (onChainPositionAddress.indexOf(':') < 0) {
    throw new Error('on-chain position address must be chain-prefixed');
  }
  await query(
    `UPDATE lp_positions
       SET on_chain_position_address = $3, updated_at = NOW()
       WHERE id = $1 AND user_id = $2`,
    [positionId, scope.userId, onChainPositionAddress]
  );
}

/**
 * Total open LP capital for a user, summed over non-closed positions. The
 * exposure cap (Track G1) measures a pool against this base, so a position
 * closing must shrink the base immediately — hence the state filter here
 * rather than a cached total.
 */
export async function sumOpenLpDeposits(scope: UserScope): Promise<number> {
  const rows = await query<{ total: number | string | null }>(
    `SELECT SUM(deposit_amount) AS total FROM lp_positions
      WHERE user_id = $1 AND state <> 'closed'`,
    [scope.userId]
  );
  const total = rows[0]?.total;
  return total === null || total === undefined ? 0 : toSafeNumber(total);
}

/**
 * The user's open capital currently committed to one pool. Chain rides along
 * because pool addresses are chain-prefixed and unique per chain.
 */
export async function sumOpenLpPoolExposure(
  scope: UserScope,
  chain: LpChain,
  poolAddress: string
): Promise<number> {
  const rows = await query<{ total: number | string | null }>(
    `SELECT SUM(deposit_amount) AS total FROM lp_positions
      WHERE user_id = $1 AND chain = $2 AND pool_address = $3 AND state <> 'closed'`,
    [scope.userId, chain, poolAddress]
  );
  const total = rows[0]?.total;
  return total === null || total === undefined ? 0 : toSafeNumber(total);
}

==> packages/db/src/lp-tracked-wallets.ts <==
import type { LpChain } from '@swat/shared';
import { query } from './client.js';
import { withTransaction } from './transaction.js';

/**
 * Tracked LP wallets and their observation tables (`059`, Track D).
 *
 * The pipeline: the wallet indexer records an observation pass into
 * `lp_wallet_snapshots` (raw time series), the PnL calculator (apps/lp Track
 * D3, using the shared net-LP-result function) closes the books per position
 * into `lp_wallet_position_results`, and the leaderboard aggregates only the
 * results table — the screen never re-derives PnL from raw series at request
 * time.
 *
 * Tracked wallets are external addresses (not tenants), so nothing here takes a
 * UserScope. They are all chain-prefixed, same shape as
 * `source_trades.wallet_address`.
 */

export interface TrackedLpWallet {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly chain: LpChain;
  /** Chain-prefixed. */
  readonly walletAddress: string;
  readonly label: string | null;
  readonly pollingCadenceSeconds: number;
  readonly lastIndexedAt: Date | null;
  readonly createdAt: Date;
}

interface WalletRow {
  id: string;
  chain: LpChain;
  wallet_address: string;
  label: string | null;
  polling_cadence_seconds: number;
  last_indexed_at: Date | null;
  created_at: Date;
}

const WALLET_COLUMNS =
  'id, chain, wallet_address, label, polling_cadence_seconds, last_indexed_at, created_at';

function toWallet(row: WalletRow): TrackedLpWallet {
  return {
    id: row.id,
    chain: row.chain,
    walletAddress: row.wallet_address,
    label: row.label,
    pollingCadenceSeconds: row.polling_cadence_seconds,
    lastIndexedAt: row.last_indexed_at,
    createdAt: row.created_at
  };
}

export interface TrackLpWalletInput {
  readonly chain: LpChain;
  /** Chain-prefixed. */
  readonly walletAddress: string;
  readonly label?: string | null;
  readonly pollingCadenceSeconds?: number;
}

export async function trackLpWallet(input: TrackLpWalletInput): Promise<TrackedLpWallet> {
  if (input.walletAddress.indexOf(':') < 0) {
    throw new Error('tracked wallet address must be chain-prefixed');
  }
  const cadence = input.pollingCadenceSeconds ?? 300;
  if (!Number.isInteger(cadence) || cadence < 30 || cadence > 86_400) {
    throw new Error(`polling cadence must be an integer in 30..86400 seconds, got ${cadence}`);
  }
  const rows = await query<WalletRow>(
    `INSERT INTO lp_tracked_wallets (chain, wallet_address, label, polling_cadence_seconds)
     VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4)
     ON CONFLICT (chain, wallet_address) DO UPDATE
       SET label = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.label, lp_tracked_wallets.label),
           polling_cadence_seconds = EXCLUDED.polling_cadence_seconds
     RETURNING ${WALLET_COLUMNS}`,
    [input.chain, input.walletAddress, input.label ?? null, cadence]
  );
  return toWallet(rows[0]!);
}

export async function untrackLpWallet(chain: LpChain, walletAddress: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const rows = await query<{ id: string }>(
    `DELETE FROM lp_tracked_wallets WHERE chain = $1 AND wallet_address = $2 RETURNING id`,
    [chain, walletAddress]
  );
  return rows.length > 0;
}

export async function listTrackedLpWallets(options: { chain?: LpChain; limit?: number } = {}): Promise<TrackedLpWallet[]> {
  const limit = options.limit ?? 500;
  if (!Number.isInteger(limit) || limit < 1 || limit > 2000) {
    throw new Error(`listTrackedLpWallets limit must be an integer in 1..2000, got ${limit}`);
  }
  const rows = options.chain
    ? await query<WalletRow>(
        `SELECT ${WALLET_COLUMNS} FROM lp_tracked_wallets WHERE chain = $1 ORDER BY created_at LIMIT $2`,
        [options.chain, limit]
      )
    : await query<WalletRow>(
        `SELECT ${WALLET_COLUMNS} FROM lp_tracked_wallets ORDER BY created_at LIMIT $1`,
        [limit]
      );
  return rows.map(toWallet);
}

/** One observed position in an index pass. */
export interface WalletPositionObservation {
  /** Chain-prefixed. */
  readonly positionAddress: string;
  /** Chain-prefixed. */
  readonly poolAddress: string;
  readonly capturedAt: Date;
  readonly positionValueUsd: number;
  readonly uncollectedFeesUsd: number;
  readonly inRange: boolean;
}

function assertObservationUsd(name: string, value: number): void {
  if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value < 0) {
    throw new Error(`lp_wallet_snapshots.${name} must be a non-negative finite number, got ${value}`);
  }
}

/**
 * Records one index pass for a wallet: the snapshot rows and the freshness
 * stamp land in one transaction, so a wallet is never marked indexed with
 * observations that failed to write.
 */
export async function recordLpWalletIndexPass(
  trackedWalletId: string,
  observations: readonly WalletPositionObservation[]
): Promise<void> {
  for (const observation of observations) {
    assertObservationUsd('position_value_usd', observation.positionValueUsd);
    assertObservationUsd('uncollected_fees_usd', observation.uncollectedFeesUsd);
    if (observation.positionAddress.indexOf(':') < 0) {
      throw new Error('observation position address must be chain-prefixed');
    }
    if (observation.poolAddress.indexOf(':') < 0) {
      throw new Error('observation pool address must be chain-prefixed');
    }
  }

  await withTransaction(async (client) => {
    for (const observation of observations) {
      await client.query(
        `INSERT INTO lp_wallet_snapshots
           (tracked_wallet_id, position_address, pool_address, captured_at,
            position_value_usd, uncollected_fees_usd, in_range)
         VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7)
         ON CONFLICT (tracked_wallet_id, position_address, captured_at) DO NOTHING`,
        [
          trackedWalletId,
          observation.positionAddress,
          observation.poolAddress,
          observation.capturedAt,
          observation.positionValueUsd,
          observation.uncollectedFeesUsd,
          observation.inRange
        ]
      );
    }
    await client.query(
      `UPDATE lp_tracked_wallets SET last_indexed_at = NOW() WHERE id = $1`,
      [trackedWalletId]
    );
  });
}

export interface WalletPositionResultInput {
  /** Chain-prefixed. */
  readonly positionAddress: string;
  /** Chain-prefixed. */
  readonly poolAddress: string;
  readonly chain: LpChain;
  readonly strategyType: 'spot' | 'curve' | 'bidask';
  readonly netResultUsd: number;
  readonly firstObservedAt: Date;
  readonly lastObservedAt: Date;
  readonly closed: boolean;
}

/** Track D3 output: one closed book per position. Upsert, keyed by (wallet, position). */
export async function upsertLpWalletPositionResult(
  trackedWalletId: string,
  input: WalletPositionResultInput
): Promise<void> {
  if (!Number.isFinite(input.netResultUsd)) {
    throw new Error(`net_result_usd must be finite, got ${input.netResultUsd}`);
  }
  await query(
    `INSERT INTO lp_wallet_position_results
       (tracked_wallet_id, position_address, pool_address, chain, strategy_type,
        net_result_usd, first_observed_at, last_observed_at, closed, updated_at)
     VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9, NOW())
     ON CONFLICT (tracked_wallet_id, position_address) DO UPDATE
       SET net_result_usd    = EXCLUDED.net_result_usd,
           last_observed_at  = EXCLUDED.last_observed_at,
           closed            = EXCLUDED.closed,
           updated_at        = EXCLUDED.updated_at`,
    [
      trackedWalletId,
      input.positionAddress,
      input.poolAddress,
      input.chain,
      input.strategyType,
      input.netResultUsd,
      input.firstObservedAt,
      input.lastObservedAt,
      input.closed
    ]
  );
}

export type LeaderboardSort = 'pnl' | 'winRate';

export interface LpLeaderboardEntry {
  readonly trackedWalletId: string;
  readonly chain: LpChain;
  /** Chain-prefixed. */
  readonly walletAddress: string;
  readonly label: string | null;
  readonly realizedPnlUsd: number;
  /** Closed positions only; `null` when the wallet has no closed positions yet. */
  readonly winRate: number | null;
  readonly closedPositionCount: number;
  readonly dominantStrategyType: 'spot' | 'curve' | 'bidask' | null;
}

interface LeaderboardRow {
  tracked_wallet_id: string;
  chain: LpChain;
  wallet_address: string;
  label: string | null;
  realized_pnl_usd: number | string;
  win_rate: number | string | null;
  closed_position_count: number | string;
  dominant_strategy_type: 'spot' | 'curve' | 'bidask' | null;
}

/** NUMERIC arrives as number (fits float64) or string (does not) — never round silently. */
function toSafeNumber(value: number | string): number {
  if (typeof value === 'number') return value;
  const parsed = Number(value);
  if (!Number.isFinite(parsed)) {
    throw new Error(`stored NUMERIC ${String(value)} does not fit a float64`);
  }
  return parsed;
}

/**
 * The LP Wallets screen. Win rate counts closed positions only — an open
 * position has no realized result to vote on — and `dominant_strategy_type` is
 * the modal strategy across all observed positions.
 */
export async function queryLpWalletLeaderboard(options: {  chain?: LpChain;
  sort?: LeaderboardSort;
  limit?: number;
} = {}): Promise<LpLeaderboardEntry[]> {
  const limit = options.limit ?? 25;
  if (!Number.isInteger(limit) || limit < 1 || limit > 100) {
    throw new Error(`queryLpWalletLeaderboard limit must be an integer in 1..100, got ${limit}`);
  }
  const sortExpression = options.sort === 'winRate'
    ? 'win_rate DESC NULLS LAST, realized_pnl_usd DESC'
    : 'realized_pnl_usd DESC';

  const rows = options.chain
    ? await query<LeaderboardRow>(
        `SELECT
           w.id                                   AS tracked_wallet_id,
           w.chain                                AS chain,
           w.wallet_address                       AS wallet_address,
           w.label                                AS label,
           COALESCE(SUM(r.net_result_usd), 0)     AS realized_pnl_usd,
           CASE WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.closed) > 0
                THEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.closed AND r.net_result_usd > 0)::numeric
                     / COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.closed)
                END                                AS win_rate,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.closed)        AS closed_position_count,
           MODE() WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY r.strategy_type) AS dominant_strategy_type
         FROM lp_tracked_wallets w
         LEFT JOIN lp_wallet_position_results r ON r.tracked_wallet_id = w.id
         WHERE w.chain = $1
         GROUP BY w.id, w.chain, w.wallet_address, w.label
         ORDER BY ${sortExpression}
         LIMIT $2`,
        [options.chain, limit]
      )
    : await query<LeaderboardRow>(
        `SELECT
           w.id                                   AS tracked_wallet_id,
           w.chain                                AS chain,
           w.wallet_address                       AS wallet_address,
           w.label                                AS label,
           COALESCE(SUM(r.net_result_usd), 0)     AS realized_pnl_usd,
           CASE WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.closed) > 0
                THEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.closed AND r.net_result_usd > 0)::numeric
                     / COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.closed)
                END                                AS win_rate,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.closed)        AS closed_position_count,
           MODE() WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY r.strategy_type) AS dominant_strategy_type
         FROM lp_tracked_wallets w
         LEFT JOIN lp_wallet_position_results r ON r.tracked_wallet_id = w.id
         GROUP BY w.id, w.chain, w.wallet_address, w.label
         ORDER BY ${sortExpression}
         LIMIT $1`,
        [limit]
      );

  return rows.map((row) => ({
    trackedWalletId: row.tracked_wallet_id,
    chain: row.chain,
    walletAddress: row.wallet_address,
    label: row.label,
    realizedPnlUsd: toSafeNumber(row.realized_pnl_usd),
    winRate: row.win_rate === null ? null : toSafeNumber(row.win_rate),
    closedPositionCount: Number(row.closed_position_count),
    dominantStrategyType: row.dominant_strategy_type
  }));
}

/** A deep pair: $200k TVL, so $100k of one-sided usable liquidity. */
function deepLiquidity(): UsableLiquidity {
  return usableLiquidityFromPoolTvlUsd('solana', 'solana:TOKEN', 200_000);

function input(overrides: Partial<MasterCapacityInput> = {}): MasterCapacityInput {
  return {
    masterWalletAddress: 'solana:MASTER',
    chain: 'solana',
    tokenMint: 'solana:TOKEN',
    windowMs: MASTER_CAPACITY_WINDOWS.fanoutDrainMs,

      coverage: 'accounted'

    ...overrides
  };

describe('priceImpactBps', () => {
  it('is notional over the one-sided reserve, in bps', () => {
    // Constant product: average execution price / spot = 1 + dx/x exactly.
    expect(priceImpactBps(1_000, 100_000)).toBe(100);
    expect(priceImpactBps(500, 100_000)).toBe(50);
    expect(priceImpactBps(0, 100_000)).toBe(0);
  });

  it('refuses a non-positive or non-finite reserve rather than dividing by it', () => {
    expect(() => priceImpactBps(100, 0)).toThrow(MasterCapacityInputError);
    expect(() => priceImpactBps(100, -1)).toThrow(MasterCapacityInputError);
    expect(() => priceImpactBps(100, Number.NaN)).toThrow(MasterCapacityInputError);
  });

  it('refuses a negative notional', () => {
    expect(() => priceImpactBps(-1, 100_000)).toThrow(MasterCapacityInputError);
  });

  it('round-trips through capacityNotionalUsd', () => {
    const cap = capacityNotionalUsd(100_000, 250);
    expect(cap).toBe(2_500);
    expect(priceImpactBps(cap, 100_000)).toBe(250);
  });
});

describe('usableLiquidityFromPoolTvlUsd', () => {
  it('halves a both-sided TVL and marks the figure approximate', () => {
    const liquidity = usableLiquidityFromPoolTvlUsd('solana', 'solana:TOKEN', 200_000);
    expect(liquidity.usableLiquidityUsd).toBe(100_000);
    expect(liquidity.basis).toBe('amm-pool-tvl');
    expect(liquidity.approximate).toBe(true);
  });

  it('reports a missing, zero or non-finite TVL as unknown and never as zero', () => {
    for (const tvl of [null, 0, Number.NaN, -5]) {
      const liquidity = usableLiquidityFromPoolTvlUsd('solana', 'solana:TOKEN', tvl);
      expect(liquidity.basis).toBe('unknown');
      expect(liquidity.usableLiquidityUsd).toBeNull();
    }
  });
});

describe('platform limits', () => {
  it('derives the impact ceiling from the chain default slippage tolerance', () => {

      );
      expect(PLATFORM_MAX_AGGREGATE_IMPACT_BPS[chain]).toBeLessThan(DEFAULT_SLIPPAGE_BPS[chain]);

  it('is a real number on every chain, so no chain ships with the cap disabled', () => {
    for (const value of Object.values(PLATFORM_MAX_AGGREGATE_IMPACT_BPS)) {

    }
  });
});

describe('assessMasterCapacity — primary price-impact cap', () => {
  it('admits flow well under the ceiling and reports nothing unassessed', () => {
    const decision = assessMasterCapacity(input());
    expect(decision.outcome).toBe('admit');
    expect(decision.reasonCode).toBe('capacity-within-limits');
    expect(decision.binding).toEqual([]);
    expect(decision.unassessed).toEqual([]);
    expect(decision.user.message).toBeNull();
    expect(decision.internal.priceImpact?.totalImpactBps).toBe(100);
    expect(decision.internal.priceImpact?.capBps).toBe(500);
  });

  it('skips when committed plus projected exceeds the ceiling', () => {
    const decision = assessMasterCapacity(
      input({
        observation: {
          committedNotionalUsd: 45_000,
          projectedNotionalUsd: 10_000,
          coverage: 'accounted'
        }
      })
    );
    expect(decision.outcome).toBe('skip');
    expect(decision.reasonCode).toBe('capacity-price-impact-cap-reached');
    expect(decision.binding).toContain('aggregate-price-impact');
    expect(decision.internal.priceImpact?.totalImpactBps).toBe(5_500);
  });

  it('admits at exactly the ceiling and skips one dollar past it', () => {
    // 500 bps of $100,000 usable liquidity is $5,000 of notional.
    const at = assessMasterCapacity(
      input({
        observation: { committedNotionalUsd: 0, projectedNotionalUsd: 5_000, coverage: 'accounted' }
      })
    );
    expect(at.outcome).toBe('admit');
    const past = assessMasterCapacity(
      input({
        observation: { committedNotionalUsd: 0, projectedNotionalUsd: 5_001, coverage: 'accounted' }
      })
    );
    expect(past.outcome).toBe('skip');
  });

  it('counts already-committed flow, so the cohort cannot re-spend its own headroom', () => {
    const decision = assessMasterCapacity(
      input({
        observation: {
          committedNotionalUsd: 4_900,
          projectedNotionalUsd: 200,
          coverage: 'accounted'
        }
      })
    );
    expect(decision.outcome).toBe('skip');
    expect(decision.internal.priceImpact?.headroomUsd).toBeCloseTo(100, 6);
  });

  it('uses the per-chain ceiling, so the same flow can pass on solana and fail on polygon', () => {
    const observation = {
      committedNotionalUsd: 0,
      projectedNotionalUsd: 2_000,
      coverage: 'accounted' as const
    };
    const solana = assessMasterCapacity(input({ observation }));
    const polygon = assessMasterCapacity(
      input({
        chain: 'polygon',
        masterWalletAddress: 'polygon:0xmaster',
        tokenMint: 'polygon:0xtoken',
        liquidity: usableLiquidityFromPoolTvlUsd('polygon', 'polygon:0xtoken', 200_000),
        observation
      })
    );
    expect(solana.outcome).toBe('admit');
    expect(polygon.outcome).toBe('skip');
  });

  it('honours a per-master ceiling override', () => {
    const decision = assessMasterCapacity(
      input({ policy: { unassessablePolicy: 'skip', maxAggregateImpactBps: 50 } })
    );
    expect(decision.outcome).toBe('skip');
    expect(decision.internal.priceImpact?.capBps).toBe(50);
  });
});

    );
    expect(byFollowers.user.message).toBe(byImpact.user.message);
    expect(byUnassessable.user.message).toBe(byImpact.user.message);
    expect(byFollowers.internal.code).not.toBe(byImpact.internal.code);
    expect(byUnassessable.internal.code).not.toBe(byImpact.internal.code);
  });

  it('never leaks a figure or a follower count to the user (S4-M9)', () => {
    const decision = assessMasterCapacity(input({ activeFollowerCount: 873 }));

    expect(userFacing).not.toMatch(/follower/i);
    expect(userFacing).not.toMatch(/liquidity/i);
    expect(userFacing).not.toMatch(/impact/i);
    expect(userFacing).not.toMatch(/bps/i);
    expect(userFacing).not.toMatch(/quota/i);
    expect(CAPACITY_USER_MESSAGE).not.toMatch(/\d/);
  });

  it('says nothing to the user on an admit', () => {

      tokenMint: 'solana:TOKEN',
      sourceTradeId: '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001',
      executionMode: 'paper',
      notionalUsd: 1_500,
      notionalBasis: 'quote-stablecoin',
      committedAt: WINDOW_END
    });
    const [sql] = mocks.query.mock.calls[0] as [string, unknown[]];
    expect(sql).toMatch(/ON CONFLICT \(source_trade_id, execution_mode\) DO NOTHING/);
    expect(sql).not.toMatch(/user_id/);
  });

  it('turns an absent policy row into platform defaults rather than nulls', async () => {
    mocks.query.mockResolvedValueOnce([]);
    const result = await fetchMasterCapacityPolicy({
      masterWalletAddress: 'solana:MASTER',
      chain: 'solana'
    });
    expect(result.policy).toEqual({
      maxAggregateImpactBps: undefined,
      followerSoftCap: undefined
    });
    expect(result.dailyBudgetShareBps).toBeNull();
  });

  it('passes per-master overrides through unchanged', async () => {
    mocks.query.mockResolvedValueOnce([
      { max_aggregate_impact_bps: 75, follower_soft_cap: 20, daily_budget_share_bps: 1_200 }
    ]);
    const result = await fetchMasterCapacityPolicy({
      masterWalletAddress: 'solana:MASTER',
      chain: 'solana'
    });
    expect(result.policy).toEqual({ maxAggregateImpactBps: 75, followerSoftCap: 20 });
    expect(result.dailyBudgetShareBps).toBe(1_200);
  });
});

describe('subtractDecimalText', () => {
  it('subtracts exactly, without binary floating point drift', () => {
    // 0.3 - 0.1 is 0.19999999999999998 in JS. A numerator assembled from
    // hundreds of those drifts against the NUMERIC column it mirrors.
    expect(subtractDecimalText('0.3', '0.1')).toBe('0.2');
    expect(subtractDecimalText('1500.75', '1000.25')).toBe('500.5');
    expect(subtractDecimalText('0.000000001', '0')).toBe('0.000000001');
  });

  it('returns a signed result rather than clamping a negative difference', () => {
    expect(subtractDecimalText('10', '25')).toBe('-15');
  });

  it('is zero, not negative zero, when the two figures are equal', () => {
    expect(subtractDecimalText('150.00', '150')).toBe('0');
    expect(subtractDecimalText('0', '0')).toBe('0');
  });

  it('rejects an unparseable or negative input rather than guessing', () => {
    expect(subtractDecimalText('abc', '1')).toBeNull();
    expect(subtractDecimalText('', '1')).toBeNull();
    expect(subtractDecimalText('-5', '1')).toBeNull();
    expect(subtractDecimalText(null, '1')).toBeNull();
  });
});

describe('pricedBasisForQuoteCurrency', () => {
  it('calls a USD-settled fill quote-stablecoin', () => {
    // Polymarket settles in USDC/pUSD, treated 1:1, and paper sizes in USD.
    expect(pricedBasisForQuoteCurrency('USD')).toBe('quote-stablecoin');
  });

  it('calls a SOL or ETH settled fill marked-to-price, because a rate was applied', () => {
    expect(pricedBasisForQuoteCurrency('SOL')).toBe('marked-to-price');
    expect(pricedBasisForQuoteCurrency('ETH')).toBe('marked-to-price');
  });

  it('returns null for an unknown currency rather than defaulting a basis', () => {
    expect(pricedBasisForQuoteCurrency(null)).toBeNull();
    expect(pricedBasisForQuoteCurrency(undefined)).toBeNull();
  });
});

describe('mergePricedBasis', () => {
  it('takes the incoming basis over an unpriced row', () => {
    expect(mergePricedBasis('unpriced', 'quote-stablecoin')).toBe('quote-stablecoin');
    expect(mergePricedBasis(null, 'marked-to-price')).toBe('marked-to-price');
  });

  it('keeps the basis when it already matches', () => {
    expect(mergePricedBasis('quote-stablecoin', 'quote-stablecoin')).toBe('quote-stablecoin');
  });

  it('degrades a mixed row to marked-to-price, never upgrades it to quote-stablecoin', () => {
    // A sum containing a rate-converted leg is only as trustworthy as the rate.
    expect(mergePricedBasis('quote-stablecoin', 'marked-to-price')).toBe('marked-to-price');
    expect(mergePricedBasis('marked-to-price', 'quote-stablecoin')).toBe('marked-to-price');
  });
});

function accrual(
  overrides: Partial<CapacityFillAccrualInput> = {}
): CapacityFillAccrualInput {
  return {
    sourceTradeId: '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001',
    executionMode: 'live',
    quoteCurrency: 'USD',
    confirmedQuoteUsdBefore: null,
    confirmedQuoteUsdAfter: '150',
    ...overrides
  };
}

describe('decideCapacityFillAccrual', () => {
  it('accrues the increment between the cumulative totals, with a basis', () => {
    const decision = decideCapacityFillAccrual(
      accrual({ confirmedQuoteUsdBefore: '100', confirmedQuoteUsdAfter: '250.5' })
    );
    expect(decision.code).toBe('accrue');
    expect(decision.deltaUsd).toBe('150.5');
    expect(decision.notionalBasis).toBe('quote-stablecoin');
  });

  it('accrues the whole total on the first priced fill, when nothing was valued before', () => {
    const decision = decideCapacityFillAccrual(accrual({ confirmedQuoteUsdBefore: null }));
    expect(decision.code).toBe('accrue');
    expect(decision.deltaUsd).toBe('150');
  });

  it('accrues only the increment on a second partial fill, never the whole total again', () => {
    // The reason the input is a cumulative pair rather than a per-fill amount:
    // a per-fill amount would count the first partial twice.
    const decision = decideCapacityFillAccrual(
      accrual({ confirmedQuoteUsdBefore: '150', confirmedQuoteUsdAfter: '400' })
    );
    expect(decision.deltaUsd).toBe('250');
  });

  it('is a no-op when the cumulative total did not move, so a retry cannot double-count', () => {
    // The self-correcting half of the caller's idempotency contract: a BullMQ
    // retry re-presents the same evidence row, whose insert is ON CONFLICT DO
    // NOTHING, so the total is unchanged and the delta is zero by arithmetic.
    const decision = decideCapacityFillAccrual(
      accrual({ confirmedQuoteUsdBefore: '150', confirmedQuoteUsdAfter: '150' })
    );
    expect(decision.code).toBe('no-new-usd');
    expect(decision.deltaUsd).toBeNull();
  });

  it('never accrues a zero when nothing about the fill is valued in USD', () => {
    // A zero would read as "this cohort spent nothing" and turn the window from a
    // declared lower bound into a complete sum that is neither.
    const decision = decideCapacityFillAccrual(
      accrual({ confirmedQuoteUsdBefore: null, confirmedQuoteUsdAfter: null, quoteCurrency: null })
    );
    expect(decision.code).toBe('fill-value-unknown');
    expect(decision.deltaUsd).toBeNull();
    expect(decision.notionalBasis).toBeNull();
  });

  it('leaves the row unpriced when a USD figure moved but no settlement currency was reported', () => {
    const decision = decideCapacityFillAccrual(
      accrual({ confirmedQuoteUsdBefore: '10', confirmedQuoteUsdAfter: '60', quoteCurrency: null })
    );
    expect(decision.code).toBe('fill-value-unknown');
    expect(decision.deltaUsd).toBeNull();
  });

  it('refuses a negative delta rather than subtracting it below zero', () => {
    const decision = decideCapacityFillAccrual(
      accrual({ confirmedQuoteUsdBefore: '400', confirmedQuoteUsdAfter: '150' })
    );
    expect(decision.code).toBe('refuse-reversed-fill');
    expect(decision.deltaUsd).toBeNull();
  });

  it('refuses a total that became unknown after being valued', () => {
    const decision = decideCapacityFillAccrual(
      accrual({ confirmedQuoteUsdBefore: '400', confirmedQuoteUsdAfter: null })
    );
    expect(decision.code).toBe('refuse-reversed-fill');
  });

  it('marks a SOL-settled fill marked-to-price, so the per-chain basis is not one constant', () => {
    const decision = decideCapacityFillAccrual(accrual({ quoteCurrency: 'SOL' }));
    expect(decision.notionalBasis).toBe('marked-to-price');
  });

  it('refuses per-user data in the accrual input, so this write cannot introduce a user dimension', () => {
    expect(() =>
      decideCapacityFillAccrual({
        ...accrual(),
        // @ts-expect-error deliberately widening the type the way a future change might
        targetAccount: 'solana:USERWALLET'
      })
    ).toThrow(MasterCapacityInputError);
  });

  it('rejects an unparseable cumulative figure loudly instead of treating it as unknown', () => {
    expect(() =>
      decideCapacityFillAccrual(accrual({ confirmedQuoteUsdAfter: 'not-a-number' }))
    ).toThrow(MasterCapacityInputError);
    expect(() =>
      decideCapacityFillAccrual(accrual({ confirmedQuoteUsdBefore: '-5' }))
    ).toThrow(MasterCapacityInputError);
  });

  it('rejects an execution mode 053 would not admit', () => {
    expect(() =>
      // @ts-expect-error `off` is an ExecutionMode but not a ledger mode
      decideCapacityFillAccrual(accrual({ executionMode: 'off' }))
    ).toThrow(MasterCapacityInputError);
  });
});

describe('accrueMasterCapacityFillNotional (mocked client)', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    mocks.query.mockReset();
  });

  it('accumulates onto the existing cohort row instead of inserting a second one', async () => {
    // The unique key is (source_trade_id, execution_mode) and the row is
    // cohort-level. A per-fill INSERT would collide, DO NOTHING would keep the
    // first row, and the first confirmed user's fill would masquerade as the
    // whole cohort's notional.
    mocks.query.mockResolvedValueOnce([
      { notional_usd: '150', notional_basis: 'quote-stablecoin' }
    ]);
    const result = await accrueMasterCapacityFillNotional(accrual());
    const [sql, params] = mocks.query.mock.calls[0] as [string, unknown[]];
    expect(sql).toMatch(/^UPDATE master_capacity_ledger/);
    expect(sql).not.toMatch(/INSERT/i);
    expect(sql).toMatch(/COALESCE\(notional_usd, 0\) \+ \$1::numeric/);
    expect(sql).toMatch(/WHERE source_trade_id = \$3::uuid\s+AND execution_mode = \$4/);
    expect(params).toEqual([
      '150',
      'quote-stablecoin',
      '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001',
      'live'
    ]);
    expect(result.applied).toBe(true);
    expect(result.notionalUsd).toBe('150');
  });

  it('sets notional_usd and notional_basis in one statement, because 053 couples them', async () => {
    // chk_master_capacity_ledger_basis is
    //   (notional_basis = 'unpriced') = (notional_usd IS NULL)
    // and a CHECK is evaluated per row per statement, so a two-statement version
    // fails on whichever half runs first.
    mocks.query.mockResolvedValueOnce([
      { notional_usd: '150', notional_basis: 'quote-stablecoin' }
    ]);
    await accrueMasterCapacityFillNotional(accrual());
    expect(mocks.query).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    const [sql] = mocks.query.mock.calls[0] as [string, unknown[]];
    expect(sql).toMatch(/SET notional_usd =[\s\S]*notional_basis = CASE/);
    expect(sql.match(/UPDATE master_capacity_ledger/g)).toHaveLength(1);
  });

  it('carries no user dimension into the ledger write', async () => {
    mocks.query.mockResolvedValueOnce([
      { notional_usd: '150', notional_basis: 'quote-stablecoin' }
    ]);
    await accrueMasterCapacityFillNotional(accrual());
    const [sql] = mocks.query.mock.calls[0] as [string, unknown[]];
    expect(sql).not.toMatch(/user_id|target_account/);
  });

  it('issues no statement at all when the fill USD value is unknown', async () => {
    const result = await accrueMasterCapacityFillNotional(
      accrual({ confirmedQuoteUsdAfter: null, quoteCurrency: null })
    );
    expect(result.applied).toBe(false);
    expect(result.code).toBe('fill-value-unknown');
    expect(mocks.query).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('issues no statement when a retry re-presents an already-accrued fill', async () => {
    const result = await accrueMasterCapacityFillNotional(
      accrual({ confirmedQuoteUsdBefore: '150', confirmedQuoteUsdAfter: '150' })
    );
    expect(result.code).toBe('no-new-usd');
    expect(mocks.query).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('reports a missing cohort row instead of silently dropping real flow', async () => {
    // The fan-out writer swallows its failures, so a fill can arrive for a
    // fan-out that has no row. Under-counting the numerator permits larger
    // cohorts than it should, which fails OPEN.
    mocks.query.mockResolvedValueOnce([]);
    const result = await accrueMasterCapacityFillNotional(accrual());
    expect(result.applied).toBe(false);
    expect(result.code).toBe('ledger-row-missing');
    expect(result.reason).toMatch(/MISSING from the capacity numerator/);
  });

  it('degrades a mixed cohort row to marked-to-price in the statement itself', async () => {
    mocks.query.mockResolvedValueOnce([
      { notional_usd: '150', notional_basis: 'marked-to-price' }
    ]);
    await accrueMasterCapacityFillNotional(accrual({ quoteCurrency: 'USD' }));
    const [sql] = mocks.query.mock.calls[0] as [string, unknown[]];
    expect(sql).toMatch(/ELSE 'marked-to-price'/);
  });
});

==> packages/db/src/master-capacity.ts <==
import type { Chain } from '@swat/shared';
import { DEFAULT_SLIPPAGE_BPS } from '@swat/shared';
import { query } from './client.js';
import type { QuoteCurrency } from './quote-valuation.js';

/**
 * Per-master capacity cap, denominated in **price impact** (`S4-M6`, migration
 * `053`).
 *
 * ── The harm ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 *
 * Our own cohort is the adverse selection. When one master's trade fans out to
 * hundreds of followers, the copies land as one directional order on the same
 * pair inside a few minutes. User #900 buys at a price users #1-899 created.
 * A master who notices can farm it deliberately: buy small, wait for the copy
 * flow to lift the price, sell into their own followers.
 *
 * ── Why not follower count ────────────────────────────────────────────────
 *
 * Follower count is the wrong unit. 500 followers buying a deep pair move it by
 * basis points; 50 buying a fresh memecoin move it by tens of percent. The
 * quantity that actually describes the harm is **aggregate copy notional as a
 * fraction of usable liquidity**, which is what this module caps.
 *
 * A follower soft-cap survives as a **crude secondary** (`followerSoftCap`) so
 * that no single master becomes an operational concentration risk regardless of
 * what they trade. It is crude on purpose and labelled as such: it knows nothing
 * about the venue. Both layers bind independently — neither is a fallback for
 * the other, and the secondary is the only layer left standing when liquidity is
 * unknown, which is exactly when it earns its keep.
 *
 * ── Uniform skip: an encoding, not a promise ──────────────────────────────
 *
 * When capacity binds, **everyone is skipped uniformly** (ADR-0005 4.2-4.4, and
 * `S4-M7`). There is no tier priority, no first-come admission, no per-user
 * ordering. That is enforced structurally rather than by review:
 *
 *   * `MasterCapacityInput` contains **no per-user field whatsoever** — no user
 *     id, no tier, no plan, no target account, no per-user requested notional.
 *     The decision is a property of the (master, token, window) triple.
 *   * `assertNoPerUserCapacityInput` re-checks that at runtime by key name and
 *     throws, so a future field called `userTier` cannot be threaded in quietly.
 *   * The impact cap is derived from the **chain default** slippage tolerance,
 *     never from any user's own tolerance, so a looser user cannot buy a bigger
 *     cohort allowance.
 *
 * A function that cannot see a tier cannot prioritise by one.
 *
 * ── Two messages, one decision ────────────────────────────────────────────
 *
 * Every decision carries both `user.message` (generic, digit-free, drawn from a
 * frozen constant) and `internal.code` + `internal.detail` (specific, with
 * figures). They are returned together so a caller cannot reach for the wrong
 * one, and `internal` is nested under a name that makes rendering it to a user
 * obvious in review. Nothing under `internal` is ever user-visible.
 *
 * Follower counts are **never displayed** (`S4-M9`), and a capacity figure must
 * not become a way to infer one: the follower count appears only under
 * `internal`, and the user string carries no digits at all.
 *
 * ── Pure / DB split ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
 *
 * Everything above `--- DB ---` is pure: no clock, no database, no network.
 * `assessMasterCapacity` takes liquidity, the accounted notional and the
 * follower count as **injected inputs**. Below `--- DB ---` are three thin
 * readers/writers over `053`'s tables and nothing else.
 */

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Liquidity: what actually exists, and what does not
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * Where a usable-liquidity figure came from — because on two of three venues,
 * at fan-out decision time, the honest answer is "nowhere".
 *
 * This enum is the most important type in the module. A capacity cap that
 * silently substitutes a fabricated liquidity number is worse than no cap: it
 * would block everything or permit everything while looking like a control.
 *
 * **What this repo actually has, verified rather than assumed:**
 *
 *   * `fetchDexScreenerLiquidity(mint, chain)` (`packages/shared/src/prices.ts`)
 *     returns DexScreener's `liquidity.usd` for the **deepest single pair** on
 *     the chain. It is already called at decision time by
 *     `apps/signal-engine/src/safety.ts` for the low-liquidity flag, so the call
 *     is proven to work on this path. It is a **pool TVL**, both sides summed —
 *     not depth, not a quote, and not persisted in any table (no column in
 *     `packages/db/sql/` holds a liquidity figure; only the `min_liquidity_usd`
 *     threshold in `config`). It returns `null` when no pair matches.
 *   * Jupiter's quote carries a real per-trade `priceImpactPct`
 *     (`packages/shared/src/jupiter.ts`, persisted to `trades.price_impact_pct`
 *     by `007`). It is Solana-only, it is per order, and it is obtained inside
 *     the executor at simulation time — after fan-out has already been decided.
 *   * Polymarket's order book gives genuine depth, and the executor already
 *     walks it against a bps bound (`apps/trade-executor/src/polymarket.ts`).
 *     Also at submission time, also per order. Polymarket outcome tokens trade
 *     on Polymarket's own CLOB rather than on a DEX pair, so the DexScreener
 *     route is not expected to cover them — that is a property of the venue and
 *     is NOT something this repo verifies, so treat it as reasoning to confirm
 *     rather than a measured fact. Either way the AMM route returning `null` is
 *     handled: it becomes `basis: 'unknown'`, not a zero.
 *
 * So: a *pool-TVL* figure exists for AMM pairs and nothing exists before
 * fan-out for Polymarket. Both are injected here with the basis attached.
 */
export type UsableLiquidityBasis =
  /**
   * DexScreener pool TVL for the deepest pair, converted to a one-sided
   * quote reserve by `usableLiquidityFromPoolTvlUsd`. Approximate: it is one
   * pair rather than all routes, it is a reported TVL rather than a quote, and
   * for a concentrated-liquidity pool the constant-product model below is only
   * a rough guide.
   */
  | 'amm-pool-tvl'
  /**
   * Resting size within a price bound, summed from an order book. This is the
   * *right* number for Polymarket and **nothing in this repo supplies it before
   * fan-out** — the book is read inside the executor at submission. Accepted
   * here so that wiring a pre-fan-out book read later needs no change to this
   * module.
   */
  | 'order-book-depth'
  /**
   * No figure. Not zero, not "thin" — unknown. Routed to the unassessable path,
   * never treated as a number.
   */
  | 'unknown';

export interface UsableLiquidity {
  readonly chain: Chain;
  readonly tokenMint: string;
  /**
   * USD notional that can be absorbed on **one side** of the market — the quote
   * reserve for an AMM, resting size within the bound for a book. `null`
   * whenever the basis is `unknown`, and `null` is never coerced to 0.
   */
  readonly usableLiquidityUsd: number | null;
  readonly basis: UsableLiquidityBasis;
  /** True when the figure stands in for something more precise. */
  readonly approximate: boolean;
  /** Where it came from, for the operator reading a skip they doubt. */
  readonly note: string;
}

/**
 * A liquidity input for a token nobody can price. The only honest constructor
 * when the fetch failed or the venue has no pre-trade depth feed.
 */
export function unknownLiquidity(
  chain: Chain,
  tokenMint: string,
  note: string
): UsableLiquidity {
  return Object.freeze({
    chain,
    tokenMint,
    usableLiquidityUsd: null,
    basis: 'unknown' as const,
    approximate: false,
    note
  });
}

/**
 * Converts a both-sided pool TVL into the one-sided reserve the impact model
 * needs, i.e. halves it.
 *
 * DexScreener's `liquidity.usd` values both legs of the pair. For a balanced
 * constant-product pool the quote reserve is half of it. For a pool that is not
 * balanced this is wrong in whichever direction the imbalance runs, which is
 * one of the reasons the result is marked `approximate`.
 */
export function usableLiquidityFromPoolTvlUsd(
  chain: Chain,
  tokenMint: string,
  poolTvlUsd: number | null
): UsableLiquidity {
  if (poolTvlUsd === null || !Number.isFinite(poolTvlUsd) || poolTvlUsd <= 0) {
    return unknownLiquidity(
      chain,
      tokenMint,
      'DexScreener returned no usable pool TVL for this token (fetchDexScreenerLiquidity '
        + 'gave null, zero or a non-finite value). Treated as unknown, not as zero.'
    );
  }
  return Object.freeze({
    chain,
    tokenMint,
    usableLiquidityUsd: poolTvlUsd / 2,
    basis: 'amm-pool-tvl' as const,
    approximate: true,
    note:
      'Half of DexScreener liquidity.usd for the deepest pair on this chain '
      + '(fetchDexScreenerLiquidity in packages/shared/src/prices.ts). A reported '
      + 'both-sided TVL for one pair, not a quote and not summed across routes; the '
      + 'one-sided reserve is approximated as TVL/2.'
  });
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// The impact model
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * Execution price impact, in basis points, of pushing `notionalUsd` of one-way
 * flow through a pool whose one-sided quote reserve is `usableLiquidityUsd`.
 *
 * **Constant product, derived rather than guessed.** For x*y = k with quote
 * reserve x, swapping in dx returns dy = y*dx/(x+dx). The average execution
 * price is dx/dy = (x+dx)/y, and the spot price is x/y, so the ratio is exactly
 * 1 + dx/x. Execution impact is therefore `notional / reserve`, with no
 * approximation in the algebra itself. (The *marginal* post-trade price moves by
 * (1+dx/x)^2 - 1, roughly twice as much; the average is the right one to cap,
 * because it is what the cohort actually pays.)
 *
 * **What the model does not capture**, stated so nobody reads the output as
 * measured: concentrated liquidity (Uniswap V3, which is what Robinhood Chain
 * routes through) can be far thinner or far deeper than a constant-product pool
 * of the same TVL depending on where the range sits; Jupiter splits across
 * routes, so the deepest pair understates real depth; and an order book is not a
 * curve at all, so this formula is only appropriate for `amm-pool-tvl`. When the
 * basis is `order-book-depth` the injected figure is already a depth-within-bound
 * and the same ratio is a reasonable reading of "fraction of the book consumed".
 */
export function priceImpactBps(notionalUsd: number, usableLiquidityUsd: number): number {
  if (!Number.isFinite(notionalUsd) || notionalUsd < 0) {
    throw new MasterCapacityInputError(
      `notionalUsd must be a non-negative finite number, got ${notionalUsd}`
    );
  }
  if (!Number.isFinite(usableLiquidityUsd) || usableLiquidityUsd <= 0) {
    throw new MasterCapacityInputError(
      `usableLiquidityUsd must be a positive finite number, got ${usableLiquidityUsd}`
    );
  }
  return (notionalUsd / usableLiquidityUsd) * 10_000;
}

/** The inverse: the notional that exactly reaches `capBps` of impact. */
export function capacityNotionalUsd(usableLiquidityUsd: number, capBps: number): number {
  if (!Number.isFinite(usableLiquidityUsd) || usableLiquidityUsd <= 0) {
    throw new MasterCapacityInputError(
      `usableLiquidityUsd must be a positive finite number, got ${usableLiquidityUsd}`
    );
  }
  if (!Number.isFinite(capBps) || capBps <= 0) {
    throw new MasterCapacityInputError(`capBps must be a positive finite number, got ${capBps}`);
  }
  return (usableLiquidityUsd * capBps) / 10_000;
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Platform limits
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * The share of a chain's **default** slippage tolerance that the cohort's own
 * self-inflicted impact is allowed to consume.
 *
 * **The shape of the argument is real; the fraction is a judgement.** Stated
 * plainly so nobody reads 1/3 as measured.
 *
 * The argument: a copier's slippage tolerance is the budget protecting them from
 * an unfavourable fill. Impact the cohort *creates* is spent out of that same
 * budget. If the cohort moves the pair by the full tolerance, the last copiers
 * fail their own slippage check and the fan-out ends in a burst of failures
 * instead of a skip — which is precisely the degradation `S4-P15` says to avoid.
 * So the cohort must leave most of the tolerance for the market's own movement
 * and the venue spread, and the cap is a fraction of it rather than all of it.
 *
 * Deliberately the **chain default** (`DEFAULT_SLIPPAGE_BPS`, `S4-P4`) and never
 * a user's own value: a per-user input would make the cohort allowance depend on
 * who happens to be in the cohort, which is the uniform-skip rule broken at the
 * root.
 */
export const AGGREGATE_IMPACT_SHARE_OF_SLIPPAGE = 1 / 3;

/**
 * Platform ceiling on aggregate cohort price impact per (master, token, window),
 * in bps, per chain.
 *
 * Derived from `DEFAULT_SLIPPAGE_BPS` so that retuning `S4-P4` moves this in
 * step instead of leaving a stale literal behind. Typed `Record<Chain, number>`
 * so adding a chain to the union fails to compile until somebody decides its
 * ceiling — a silent `undefined` here would disable the cap for the new chain.
 *
 * At the time of writing that yields 500 bps on Solana (1500 default), 100 on
 * polygon and 100 on robinhood-chain (300 each).
 */
export const PLATFORM_MAX_AGGREGATE_IMPACT_BPS: Readonly<Record<Chain, number>> = Object.freeze({
  solana: Math.floor(DEFAULT_SLIPPAGE_BPS.solana * AGGREGATE_IMPACT_SHARE_OF_SLIPPAGE),
  polygon: Math.floor(DEFAULT_SLIPPAGE_BPS.polygon * AGGREGATE_IMPACT_SHARE_OF_SLIPPAGE),
  'robinhood-chain': Math.floor(
    DEFAULT_SLIPPAGE_BPS['robinhood-chain'] * AGGREGATE_IMPACT_SHARE_OF_SLIPPAGE
  ),
  base: Math.floor(DEFAULT_SLIPPAGE_BPS.base * AGGREGATE_IMPACT_SHARE_OF_SLIPPAGE),
  ethereum: Math.floor(DEFAULT_SLIPPAGE_BPS.ethereum * AGGREGATE_IMPACT_SHARE_OF_SLIPPAGE),
  bsc: Math.floor(DEFAULT_SLIPPAGE_BPS.bsc * AGGREGATE_IMPACT_SHARE_OF_SLIPPAGE)
});

/**
 * The crude secondary: how many followers one master may fan out to on one
 * chain before the *operational* concentration risk binds, whatever they trade.
 *
 * **Crude by construction.** It knows nothing about the venue or the size of the
 * trade, which is the whole reason the primary cap exists. It is here because
 * the primary cap cannot see the queue: 500 tiny copies of a deep pair pass the
 * impact test and still put 500 orders behind one worker.
 *
 * 50 is the same drain arithmetic as `PLATFORM_MAX_CONCURRENT_POSITIONS` in
 * `position-cap.ts`, reused deliberately so there is one estimate rather than
 * two: each chain's trade queue is served by exactly one concurrency-1 worker
 * (`TRADE_QUEUES_BY_CHAIN`), a conservative 6 seconds per order drains about 50
 * per 5-minute mark-to-market window, and a fan-out wider than that cannot
 * clear one window. **The 6-second figure is an estimate, not a measurement** —
 * nothing in this repo records observed submission latency — so this inherits
 * that caveat exactly, and it is a *soft* cap for that reason.
 */
export const DEFAULT_FOLLOWER_SOFT_CAP = 50;

/**
 * Named windows, with their derivations. `windowMs` is a **required** input, not
 * a defaulted one, so a caller has to choose knowingly.
 *
 * Neither is measured; both are anchored to something real in this repo.
 */
export const MASTER_CAPACITY_WINDOWS = Object.freeze({
  /**
   * One master event's fan-out, start to finish. Anchored to the same drain
   * arithmetic as the follower soft-cap: about 50 orders through one
   * concurrency-1 worker, which is also the scorer's mark-to-market cadence.
   * Use this to cap the impact of a **single** copied trade.
   */
  fanoutDrainMs: 5 * 60 * 1000,
  /**
   * Repeated buys that still ride the same displaced price. Wider, to catch the
   * farming pattern the item describes — buy small, let the copy flow lift the
   * price, sell into it — which plays out over more than one fan-out.
   * A judgement: nothing here measures how fast a pair's price recovers.
   */
  selfImpactDecayMs: 60 * 60 * 1000
});

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Inputs
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/** An input is incoherent, or carries per-user data it must not. Fails loud. */
export class MasterCapacityInputError extends Error {
  constructor(message: string) {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'MasterCapacityInputError';
  }
}

/**
 * How trustworthy the accounted copy notional is.
 *
 * Needed because there is **no USD notional column on `copy_executions`**:
 * `028` gives base/quote quantities in token units, and `source_trades.amount_usd`
 * is nullable and absent on two chains by design (`robinhood-chain` never records
 * one, Solana omits it off USDC/USDT routes). `053` therefore keeps its own
 * ledger of priced cohort notional, and this field says what the sum is worth.
 */
export type CopyNotionalCoverage =
  /** Every leg in the window carried a USD notional. The sum is complete. */
  | 'accounted'
  /**
   * Some legs had no USD notional. The sum is a **lower bound**, so the impact
   * figure is too, and a pass may be a false pass. Carried through to the
   * decision rather than smoothed away.
   */
  | 'partial-unpriced-legs'
  /** No accounting available at all. Routed to the unassessable path. */
  | 'unavailable';

export interface MasterCapacityObservation {
  /**
   * Copy notional already committed for this (master, token) inside the window,
   * in USD. `null` only with coverage `unavailable`.
   */
  readonly committedNotionalUsd: number | null;
  /**
   * The cohort total this fan-out would add, in USD. **Cohort-level, never
   * per-user** — a per-user figure here would make the answer depend on which
   * user asked, which is the uniform-skip rule broken.
   */
  readonly projectedNotionalUsd: number;
  readonly coverage: CopyNotionalCoverage;
  /** How many legs in the window had no USD notional. For `internal` only. */
  readonly unpricedLegCount?: number;
}

export interface MasterCapacityPolicy {
  /** Per-chain ceiling override. Defaults to `PLATFORM_MAX_AGGREGATE_IMPACT_BPS`. */
  readonly maxAggregateImpactBps?: number;
  /** Crude secondary. Defaults to `DEFAULT_FOLLOWER_SOFT_CAP`. */
  readonly followerSoftCap?: number;
  /**
   * What to do when the **primary** cap cannot be evaluated — unknown liquidity,
   * or no notional accounting.
   *
   * **Required, with no default, on purpose.** Both answers are dangerous and
   * the danger is asymmetric, so the choice must appear in the caller's diff:
   *
   *   * `'skip'` fails closed. Correct for a token nobody can price — but for
   *     Polymarket, where no pre-fan-out depth feed exists at all, it is an
   *     undeclared kill switch that presents as "copying quietly stopped".
   *   * `'admit'` fails open on the primary layer only. The follower soft-cap
   *     still binds, so "admit" is never "uncapped".
   */
  readonly unassessablePolicy: 'skip' | 'admit';
}

export interface MasterCapacityInput {
  /**
   * The master wallet, chain-prefixed (`solana:ABC...`), and its chain. No user
   * identity of any kind appears in this type; see the uniform-skip note above.
   */
  readonly masterWalletAddress: string;
  readonly chain: Chain;
  readonly tokenMint: string;
  /** Window length. A parameter, not a magic number; see `MASTER_CAPACITY_WINDOWS`. */
  readonly windowMs: number;
  /** End of the window. Injected — this module never reads a clock. */
  readonly windowEndsAt: Date;
  readonly observation: MasterCapacityObservation;
  readonly liquidity: UsableLiquidity;
  /**
   * Active followers of this master on this chain. A master-level aggregate, so
   * it carries no user identity. `null` when unknown, which is its own
   * unassessed reason and never read as zero.
   *
   * Never surfaced to a user (`S4-M9`): it appears only under `internal`.
   */
  readonly activeFollowerCount: number | null;
  readonly policy: MasterCapacityPolicy;
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// Outputs
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

export type MasterCapacityOutcome = 'admit' | 'skip';

/** Which layer bound. Both layers are evaluated; more than one can appear. */
export type MasterCapacityConstraint =
  | 'aggregate-price-impact'
  | 'follower-soft-cap'
  | 'unassessable-primary';

/**
 * The stable internal reason code. **Ops-facing only.** These strings are
 * contracts: telemetry, the admin capacity surface (`S6-43`) and the skip-reason
 * breakdown all key on them, so they are appended to rather than renamed.
 */
export type MasterCapacityReasonCode =
  | 'capacity-within-limits'
  /** The primary cap bound: cohort impact would exceed the chain ceiling. */
  | 'capacity-price-impact-cap-reached'
  /** The crude secondary bound. Can co-occur with the primary. */
  | 'capacity-follower-soft-cap-reached'
  /** Primary unevaluable and policy says fail closed. */
  | 'capacity-not-assessable'
  /**
   * Primary unevaluable, policy says fail open, and the secondary passed. An
   * admit that is **not** a clean pass, and a distinct code so a dashboard can
   * never show it as one.
   */
  | 'capacity-admitted-unassessed';

/** Why the primary cap could not be evaluated. Never conflated with "passed". */
export type MasterCapacityUnassessedReason =
  /** No liquidity figure at all (`basis: 'unknown'` or a null value). */
  | 'liquidity-unknown'
  /**
   * A basis exists but no pre-fan-out feed supplies it in this repo. Distinct
   * from `liquidity-unknown` because the fix is different: build the feed.
   */
  | 'liquidity-feed-missing'
  /** No copy-notional accounting for the window. */
  | 'copy-notional-unaccounted'
  /**
   * The notional sum is a lower bound because some legs were unpriced. Recorded
   * even when the cap passes, so a pass is never mistaken for a complete check.
   */
  | 'copy-notional-partial'
  /** Follower count unknown, so the crude secondary could not be evaluated. */
  | 'follower-count-unknown';

export interface MasterCapacityUnassessed {
  readonly reason: MasterCapacityUnassessedReason;
  /** What must supply the missing input. Written for whoever has to fix it. */
  readonly detail: string;
}

export interface PriceImpactAssessment {
  readonly usableLiquidityUsd: number;
  readonly basis: UsableLiquidityBasis;
  readonly approximate: boolean;
  readonly capBps: number;
  readonly committedImpactBps: number;
  readonly projectedImpactBps: number;
  /** Committed + projected, i.e. what the cap is compared against. */
  readonly totalImpactBps: number;
  /** USD still available under the cap. Negative is clamped to 0. */
  readonly headroomUsd: number;
  /** True when the sum is a lower bound (`partial-unpriced-legs`). */
  readonly lowerBound: boolean;
}

export interface FollowerSoftCapAssessment {
  readonly activeFollowerCount: number;
  readonly softCap: number;
  /** Always true here — the layer is crude by construction. */
  readonly crude: true;
}

export interface MasterCapacityDecision {
  readonly outcome: MasterCapacityOutcome;
  /** Ops-facing. Mirrored in `internal.code` so a log line carries both halves. */
  readonly reasonCode: MasterCapacityReasonCode;
  readonly binding: readonly MasterCapacityConstraint[];
  /**
   * What this decision says **nothing** about. Present so an empty list is the
   * only thing that means "fully checked" — an admit with entries here is an
   * admit under partial information.
   */
  readonly unassessed: readonly MasterCapacityUnassessed[];
  /**
   * The only user-visible half. Generic by policy: it names no quota, no
   * liquidity figure, no follower count, and contains no digits. `null` on an
   * admit, because there is nothing to tell the user.
   */
  readonly user: { readonly message: string | null };
  /**
   * Ops-only. **Never render any of this to a user** — it names the real
   * constraint and carries the follower count, which `S4-M9` forbids showing.
   */
  readonly internal: {
    readonly code: MasterCapacityReasonCode;
    readonly detail: string;
    readonly masterWalletAddress: string;
    readonly chain: Chain;
    readonly tokenMint: string;
    readonly windowMs: number;
    readonly windowStartsAt: Date;
    readonly windowEndsAt: Date;
    readonly priceImpact: PriceImpactAssessment | null;
    readonly followerSoftCap: FollowerSoftCapAssessment | null;
  };
}

/**
 * The one string a user ever sees when capacity binds, for every cause.
 *
 * One string for every cause on purpose. Distinct wording per cause would let a
 * user distinguish "impact cap" from "follower soft cap", and the second is a
 * headcount signal (`S4-M9`) — the difference between two messages is itself an
 * information leak. It carries no digits for the same reason: a headroom number
 * plus a known trade size reconstructs the cohort.
 *
 * Wording per ADR-0005 4.2-4.4: generic, and nothing in it is false. We are
 * genuinely capacity-limited and genuinely scaling; the constraint is simply not
 * itemised to users.
 */
export const CAPACITY_USER_MESSAGE =
  'This strategy is at capacity while we scale infrastructure. Your account is fine '
  + 'and nothing was charged; copying resumes automatically when capacity frees up.';

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// The uniform-skip structural guard
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

/**
 * Key fragments that must never appear anywhere in a capacity input.
 *
 * This is the runtime half of the uniform-skip guarantee. The type already has
 * no per-user field; this catches the case where somebody widens the type, or
 * passes an object with extra properties through a structurally-typed boundary.
 * `account` is included because `target_account` is this schema's per-user key
 * on the copy tables.
 */
const FORBIDDEN_INPUT_KEY_FRAGMENTS = Object.freeze([
  'user',
  'tier',
  'subscriber',
  'entitlement',
  'priority',
  'account',
  'rank'
]);

/** Depth bound, purely to make a malformed or cyclic input fail rather than hang. */
const MAX_INPUT_SCAN_DEPTH = 8;

/**
 * Throws if the input carries anything that looks like per-user or per-tier data.
 *
 * `masterWalletAddress` is deliberately not caught: it identifies the master
 * being capped, not a follower, and the decision must obviously be keyed on it.
 */
export function assertNoPerUserCapacityInput(input: unknown, path = 'input', depth = 0): void {
  if (depth > MAX_INPUT_SCAN_DEPTH) {
    throw new MasterCapacityInputError(
      `capacity input nests deeper than ${MAX_INPUT_SCAN_DEPTH} levels at ${path}; `
        + 'refusing to assess an input this module cannot fully inspect'
    );
  }
  if (input === null || typeof input !== 'object' || input instanceof Date) return;

  if (Array.isArray(input)) {
    input.forEach((item, index) =>
      assertNoPerUserCapacityInput(item, `${path}[${index}]`, depth + 1)
    );
    return;
  }

  for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(input)) {
    const lowered = key.toLowerCase();
    const hit = FORBIDDEN_INPUT_KEY_FRAGMENTS.find((fragment) => lowered.includes(fragment));
    if (hit !== undefined) {
      throw new MasterCapacityInputError(
        `capacity input carries per-user data at ${path}.${key} (matched "${hit}"). `
          + 'Capacity binds uniformly on every user (S4-M7): the decision is a property '
          + 'of (master, token, window) and must not be able to see who is asking.'
      );
    }
    assertNoPerUserCapacityInput(value, `${path}.${key}`, depth + 1);
  }
}

// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
// The decision
// ═══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

function assertFiniteNonNegative(label: string, value: number): void {
  if (!Number.isFinite(value) || value < 0) {
    throw new MasterCapacityInputError(
      `${label} must be a non-negative finite number, got ${value}`
    );
  }
}

/**
 * Assesses per-master capacity for one (master, token, window).
 *
 * Pure: no clock, no database, no network. The same inputs always give the same
 * decision, and the decision is identical for every user by construction — there
 * is no per-user input to differ on.
 *
 * Fails **loud** on an incoherent input (`MasterCapacityInputError`) and routes a
 * *missing* one to `unassessed` plus the caller's declared
 * `unassessablePolicy`, so nothing missing is ever silently read as a pass.
 */
export function assessMasterCapacity(input: MasterCapacityInput): MasterCapacityDecision {
  assertNoPerUserCapacityInput(input);

  if (!Number.isFinite(input.windowMs) || input.windowMs <= 0) {
    throw new MasterCapacityInputError(
      `windowMs must be a positive finite number, got ${input.windowMs}`
    );
  }
  const windowEndMs = input.windowEndsAt.getTime();
  if (!Number.isFinite(windowEndMs)) {
    throw new MasterCapacityInputError('windowEndsAt must be a valid Date');
  }
  assertFiniteNonNegative('projectedNotionalUsd', input.observation.projectedNotionalUsd);

  const capBps = input.policy.maxAggregateImpactBps ?? PLATFORM_MAX_AGGREGATE_IMPACT_BPS[input.chain];
  if (!Number.isFinite(capBps) || capBps <= 0) {
    throw new MasterCapacityInputError(
      `maxAggregateImpactBps must be a positive finite number, got ${capBps}`
    );
  }
  const softCap = input.policy.followerSoftCap ?? DEFAULT_FOLLOWER_SOFT_CAP;
  if (!Number.isInteger(softCap) || softCap < 1) {
    throw new MasterCapacityInputError(`followerSoftCap must be an integer >= 1, got ${softCap}`);
  }

  const unassessed: MasterCapacityUnassessed[] = [];
  const binding: MasterCapacityConstraint[] = [];

  // ── Layer 1 (primary): aggregate price impact ──────────────────────────
  const liquidityUsd = input.liquidity.usableLiquidityUsd;
  const liquidityUsable =
    input.liquidity.basis !== 'unknown'
    && liquidityUsd !== null
    && Number.isFinite(liquidityUsd)
    && liquidityUsd > 0;

  if (!liquidityUsable) {
    unassessed.push({
      reason: input.liquidity.basis === 'order-book-depth' ? 'liquidity-feed-missing' : 'liquidity-unknown',
      detail:
        `No usable liquidity for ${input.tokenMint} on ${input.chain}: ${input.liquidity.note} `
        + 'The primary cap needs a one-sided USD depth figure at fan-out time. Today the only '
        + 'pre-fan-out source in this repo is fetchDexScreenerLiquidity (pool TVL for the '
        + 'deepest pair, packages/shared/src/prices.ts); Polymarket depth and Jupiter route '
        + 'impact are both read inside the executor at submission and neither is available here.'
    });
  }

  const notionalKnown =
    input.observation.coverage !== 'unavailable'
    && input.observation.committedNotionalUsd !== null
    && Number.isFinite(input.observation.committedNotionalUsd)
    && input.observation.committedNotionalUsd >= 0;

  if (!notionalKnown) {
    unassessed.push({
      reason: 'copy-notional-unaccounted',
      detail:
        'No accounted copy notional for this window. It must come from '
        + 'master_capacity_ledger (053), written by the fan-out path when a cohort order '
        + 'is committed. copy_executions cannot supply it: 028 stores base/quote token '
        + 'quantities and no USD notional, and source_trades.amount_usd is NULL on '
        + 'robinhood-chain and on non-stablecoin Solana routes.'
    });
  } else if (input.observation.coverage === 'partial-unpriced-legs') {
    unassessed.push({
      reason: 'copy-notional-partial',
      detail:
        `${input.observation.unpricedLegCount ?? 'Some'} leg(s) in this window carried no USD `
        + 'notional, so the accounted sum and every impact figure derived from it are LOWER '
        + 'BOUNDS. A pass here may be a false pass.'
    });
  }

  let priceImpact: PriceImpactAssessment | null = null;
  if (liquidityUsable && notionalKnown) {
    const committedUsd = input.observation.committedNotionalUsd as number;
    const reserveUsd = liquidityUsd as number;
    const committedImpactBps = priceImpactBps(committedUsd, reserveUsd);
    const projectedImpactBps = priceImpactBps(input.observation.projectedNotionalUsd, reserveUsd);
    const totalImpactBps = committedImpactBps + projectedImpactBps;
    priceImpact = {
      usableLiquidityUsd: reserveUsd,
      basis: input.liquidity.basis,
      approximate: input.liquidity.approximate,
      capBps,
      committedImpactBps,
      projectedImpactBps,
      totalImpactBps,
      headroomUsd: Math.max(0, capacityNotionalUsd(reserveUsd, capBps) - committedUsd),
      lowerBound: input.observation.coverage === 'partial-unpriced-legs'
